payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear method for calculating static embeddings using the first principal component of contextualized representations, along with performance comparisons to other models.

claims.text: Static embeddings for each word are calculated by taking the first principal component of its contextualized representations in a given layer.
Static embeddings created from lower layers of models like BERT and ELMo are more effective than those from upper layers.
Static embeddings created by taking the first principal component outperform GloVe and FastText on many benchmarks.
